premises.text: Enterprise knowledge is siloed in emails, IMs, and conversations, so people repeat work and cannot find who already knows the answer
premises.evidence_span: all the knowledge was siloed. It was siloed in emails, IMs, conversations

premises.text: A Quora-like Q&A melded with wiki flexibility creates an organically growing, searchable enterprise knowledge base organized around questions
premises.evidence_span: we take the power of a Q&A site, meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base

premises.text: Voting, enterprise anonymity for 'stupid but important' questions, and wiki crowdsourcing improve answer quality and contribution
premises.evidence_span: We have a voting mechanic that allows people to stand behind and endorse certain answers

premises.text: Users can ask and answer by email and listserv content is extracted into the searchable index
premises.evidence_span: We allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email

value.text: Help people at companies share knowledge so the first place they turn for answers is the shared base
value.evidence_span: help people at companies share knowledge

causal_links.evidence_span: There was no good knowledge base
all our content is organized around questions
people and companies live in their Outlook email boxes

notes: Corporate email verification folded into enterprise KB access. Intelligent email routing described as 'working on' and omitted as not yet a required condition. Eng/sales/CS/law use cases are applications of one platform, not separate premises. Seed investors and waitlist traction excluded. Voting/anon/wiki treated as one Q&A surface feature package (P3) alongside core Q&A+wiki premise (P2).
